notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: [p]Fixed an issue where the Steam Overlay could not be closed when opened via Shift+Tab[/p]

notes.title: Fix for Save File Loading Error​
notes.content: [p]Resolved an issue where the game failed to load save files under certain language OS settings, preventing normal gameplay.[/p]

notes.title: Added controller input statistics feature​
notes.content: [p][b]Added the function to count controller inputs​[/b][/p]

notes.title: Add backup save functionality
notes.content: [p]Increase the auto-save interval and create a backup save file when saving to prevent permanent corruption of save data due to power outages or blue screens.[/p]

notes.title: CPU/GPU Occupancy Optimization & Cross-screen Switching
notes.content: [olist][*][p]Fix the problem of high CPU and GPU usage after hiding the window[/p][/*][*][p]Add instructions for switching between multiple screens. After selecting or clicking the cat icon in the taskbar, use Win + Shift + ←/→ to switch between multiple screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Modify the treasure chest opening animation[/p][/*][*][p]Modify the bold font[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: The difficulty of achieving achievements has been reduced
notes.content: [p]Based on player feedback, we've reduced the difficulty of unlocking achievements. [/p][p]Now, simply purchasing and unlocking all songs in a theme will grant the corresponding achievement (no need to complete the songs). [/p][p]Players who have already purchased all songs will need to enter the corresponding world difficulty once to unlock the achievement.[/p]

notes.title: Now supports Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean
notes.content: [p][b]New Features​[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]The game now supports Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean interface displays.[/p][/*][/list][p]​[b]​Optimizations​[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]Removed the default addition of a startup registry entry during installation. The registry entry will only be added if the user checks "Start with Windows."[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed errors in Traditional Chinese adaptation and related configuration issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized cat movement logic to prevent the cat from moving out of the screen edges, avoiding the cat "running away."[/p][/*][*][p]Changed right-click movement to left-click movement for smoother cat control.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to close panels by clicking on blank areas for more convenient panel management.[/p][/*][/list]
